data.one_liner: Collect Net Promoter Scores via a two‑screen dialog.
data.what_it_does: Displays a dialog that asks for a score and optional feedback, then returns the values via a callback. It works on Android, iOS, web, Windows, macOS and Linux.
use_when: You need a quick NPS survey in a Flutter app
You want a ready‑made dialog without custom UI work
You want a cross‑platform solution with no external dependencies
avoid_when: You need a highly customized survey flow
You require analytics or integration with a backend
You need to collect more complex data than a score and text
